stories.title: Google krijgt hoge boete opgelegd voor ‘ontfutselen’ van locatiegegevens van consumenten in EU

en.title: Google receives high fine for 'obtaining' location data from EU consumers
en.summary: Google has been fined by EU authorities for improperly collecting location information from consumers without proper consent.

stories.title: Media die uit Witte Huis verbannen zijn spannen rechtszaak aan

en.title: Media banned from White House file lawsuit
en.summary: News organizations that were barred from the White House are pursuing legal action against the administration over the access restriction.

stories.title: Nieuwsorganisaties klagen Witte Huis aan om toegangsverbod

en.title: News organizations sue White House over access ban
en.summary: CNN, MS Now, and Politico filed suit after President Trump revoked their White House access and credentials over disagreements with their coverage.

stories.title: Raad van State kritisch op plan om verkeersboetes te verhogen: 'Disbalans'

en.title: Council of State critical of plan to increase traffic fines: 'Imbalance'
en.summary: The Council of State warned that proposed increases to traffic fines would be disproportionate compared to penalties for serious offenses.

stories.title: Ook AIVD en MIVD gebruiken AI, maar de handleiding voor wat wel/niet mag ontbreekt. ‘Ze zijn daarbij niet goed in control’, zegt de toezichthouder

en.title: Both AIVD and MIVD use AI, but guidance on what is and isn't permitted is lacking. 'They are not in good control', says the supervisor
en.summary: A Dutch oversight body reports that regulations for artificial intelligence use by the country's intelligence agencies lag behind practice, and staff lack sufficient awareness of vulnerabilities despite a proposed new intelligence law expanding powers.

stories.title: Aan Poetin gelieerde partij wint schijnverkiezingen in Rusland

en.title: Putin-aligned party wins sham elections in Russia
en.summary: Russia's pro-Putin United Russia party secured the largest share in parliamentary elections for the Duma, with independent oversight absent and previous elections marked by documented fraud.

stories.title: Opnieuw een miljoenenboete voor Google: locatiegegevens misbruikt voor reclames

en.title: Google faces another multi-million euro fine: misused location data for advertisements
en.summary: Ireland's privacy authority fined Google 403 million euros for violating regulations on user location data and must comply with European rules within six months.

stories.title: Uw consumentenproblemen worden misschien niet meer opgelost, maar u hebt nu wel primetime geitenyoga!

en.title: Your consumer problems may not be solved anymore, but you do have primetime goat yoga now!
en.summary: The headline criticizes a shift in priorities, suggesting consumer protection services are being neglected in favor of frivolous entertainment programming.

stories.title: CNN en andere media klagen Witte Huis aan vanwege intrekken perskaarten

en.title: CNN and other media sue White House over revocation of press credentials
en.summary: News organizations CNN, MS NOW, and Politico are taking legal action against President Donald Trump's decision to bar their journalists from the White House, arguing the action violates constitutional press freedom protections.

stories.title: Google krijgt boete van 403 miljoen euro vanwege verwerking locatiegegevens

en.title: Google fined 403 million euros for processing location data
en.summary: The European Union has imposed a 403 million euro fine on Google for violating regulations concerning the processing of user location data.

stories.title: Raad van State tegen kabinet: heroverweeg verhoging verkeersboetes

en.title: Council of State advises government to reconsider traffic fine increases
en.summary: The Council of State has recommended that the government reconsider planned increases to traffic fines, stating it is unclear whether the raises meet necessity and proportionality standards.

stories.title: Snelle bouw moet woningnood aanpakken, maar tekort is niet zomaar opgelost

en.title: Faster construction must address housing shortage, but deficit is not easily resolved
en.summary: The government is implementing a fifty-point housing construction acceleration plan, though experts indicate that faster building alone will not fully solve the housing shortage.
